items.question: What does Federal Law No. 2 of 2019 on the use of Information and Communication Technology in health fields regulate in the UAE?
items.gold: It regulates the use of ICT in the UAE's health care sector, including its free zones.
items.fact: ICT health law regulates health care sector ICT use

items.question: How many guides does the UAE's National Nutrition Guidelines consist of?
items.fact: National Nutrition Guidelines consist of six guides
